question.problem:
| $x$ | **$-1$** | **$1$** | **$3$** | **$5$** | **$7$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $4$ | $8$ | $11$ | $14$ | $20$ |

The vector of coefficients  of the line $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}x$ that best fits the data above can be found using linear regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix $X$ in this context?
question.worked_solution:
| $x$ | **$-1$** | **$1$** | **$3$** | **$5$** | **$7$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $4$ | $8$ | $11$ | $14$ | $20$ |

The coefficients of the line that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 5 \\ 1 & 7\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 8 \\ 11 \\ 14 \\ 20\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.
